days.title: Text Embeddings & Semantic Similarity
objectives: Understand what text embeddings are and how they represent semantic meaning
Compute cosine similarity between embedding vectors
Visualize embedding spaces using PCA and t-SNE
Compare embedding models (OpenAI vs open-source)

days.title: Vector Databases
objectives: Understand how vector databases differ from relational databases
Implement CRUD operations on a vector store
Understand approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search and HNSW indexing
Choose between local (ChromaDB/FAISS) and cloud (Pinecone) vector stores

days.title: Populating a Vector Database
objectives: Load and chunk documents for embedding
Embed and upsert documents into a vector database
Add metadata to vectors for filtered search
Build a document ingestion pipeline

days.title: Retrieval Engine & Hybrid Search
objectives: Build a query router that dispatches to SQL or vector search
Implement hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and semantic search
Understand score normalization and result merging
Evaluate retrieval quality with recall metrics

days.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
objectives: Understand the full RAG pipeline: retrieve → augment → generate
Build a RAG chatbot endpoint with FastAPI
Construct effective prompt templates for RAG
Identify and diagnose common RAG failure modes

days.title: Prompt Engineering
objectives: Master zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting
Design and version system prompts for production
Evaluate prompt performance systematically
Understand prompt injection and mitigation strategies

days.title: LLM Function Calling & Structured Outputs
objectives: Define tool schemas for LLM function calling
Orchestrate multi-tool calls and process results
Use Pydantic for structured output validation

days.title: LLM Fine-Tuning Fundamentals
objectives: Understand when to fine-tune vs. use RAG or prompting
Prepare a high-quality fine-tuning dataset in JSONL format
Train and evaluate a fine-tuned model
Monitor training loss and evaluate on held-out test cases

days.title: Fine-Tuning with LoRA / QLoRA
objectives: Understand how LoRA reduces trainable parameters
Apply QLoRA for memory-efficient fine-tuning

Evaluate fine-tuned models against base models

days.title: Chatbot Backend with FastAPI
objectives: Build a production-quality /chat REST endpoint
Manage conversation session state with SQLite
Integrate the full RAG pipeline into the chat API
Handle errors, timeouts, and invalid inputs gracefully

days.title: Chatbot Frontend with Streamlit
objectives: Connect a Streamlit UI to the FastAPI backend
Manage conversation state across Streamlit reruns

Deploy the Streamlit app locally and to Streamlit Cloud

days.title: Streaming LLM Responses
objectives: Implement server-sent events (SSE) for streaming LLM output
Handle streaming in the FastAPI backend with async generators
Consume streaming responses in the frontend

days.title: Citations, Structured Outputs & Rich Formatting
objectives: Add source citations to RAG chatbot responses
Use Pydantic to define structured claim/coverage response models
Render Markdown safely in the frontend chat interface
Implement a structured output pipeline with validation

objectives: Count tokens accurately using tiktoken
Implement sliding window truncation for long conversations
Apply conversation summarization to compress context
Balance context window usage between system prompt, history, and retrieved docs

days.title: AI Agents with ReAct
objectives: Understand the ReAct (Reason + Act) agent pattern
Convert function-calling workflows into LangChain ReAct agents
Debug agent tool selection and reasoning traces
Implement agent safety limits (max iterations, timeouts)

days.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
objectives: Design multi-agent systems with specialized sub-agents
Implement a router agent that delegates to specialists

days.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
objectives: Understand the MCP specification and its role in AI tooling
Build an MCP server exposing chatbot tools and resources

days.title: Agentic Chatbot Integration
objectives: Build a full agentic pipeline: agents + MCP + RAG + memory
Implement robust error handling and retries for agent tool calls

days.title: Evaluation & Benchmarking
objectives: Define evaluation metrics: faithfulness, relevance, groundedness, coherence
Build a benchmark dataset for the chatbot

days.title: Performance & Cost Optimization
objectives: Profile token usage across the entire pipeline
Implement semantic caching to reduce redundant LLM calls

days.title: Security & Guardrails
objectives: Understand prompt injection attack vectors and defenses
Implement input sanitization and output validation

days.title: Docker & Kubernetes Deployment
objectives: Containerize the chatbot application with Docker
Write a production-quality multi-stage Dockerfile

days.title: Monitoring & Observability
objectives: Understand observability vs. simple logging
Instrument the chatbot with Prometheus metrics
Build Grafana dashboards for AI pipeline health

days.title: Production Readiness & Testing
objectives: Define production readiness criteria for AI applications
Write integration tests for the complete chatbot pipeline

objectives: Design and build a complete AI application from scratch
